captured: 2026-11-15, 1440x900, single page (9996px tall, so viewport + mid + footer shots), no consent banner shown; Framer site, some below-fold blocks were hidden until scrolled so DOM counts are partial

families: one custom rounded sans in ExtraBold 800, Bold 700, SemiBold 600, Regular 400 (sans-serif count is Framer wrapper noise)

colors.role: text primary, deep green not black
data colours: route lines, stop signs, countdown tile

shadows: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,51,105,0.08) (only on floating hero trip cards, navy-tinted)

image_ratios.usage: hero collage of cut-out photos (vehicles, buildings, people)

motion: hero objects: 1800ms and 2500ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.56,1), single run
Framer appear-on-scroll is used (banned for PLUG)

taste.name: The number is the headline
taste.trigger: When showing live trip data inside marketing art
taste.decision: Chose a huge numeral with a tiny unit and an explicit clock time (3 / minutes; 36 minutes / Arrive at 17:20) over a sentence or a progress bar alone
taste.reason: Because a rider glances for one figure; the clock time lets them check it against reality, which is what makes it trustworthy
evidence: countdown tile: ~40px numeral over 13px unit, ratio ~3:1
ETA card: 24px/800 figure over 13px/400 arrive time
route drawn as coloured dotted segments, not decoration

taste.name: Warm tint instead of white and black
taste.trigger: When choosing neutrals for a long friendly page
taste.decision: Chose warm-tinted surfaces (#FDF5F2, #FFEEE6) and deep green text (#12452B) over pure white and #000
taste.reason: Because tinted neutrals feel human and lower glare, while dark green still reads as near-black at ~10:1 contrast on #FDF5F2

taste.name: Tight stacked display, loose body
taste.trigger: When setting multi-line headlines in one family
taste.decision: Chose line-height 1.0 on 60-72px ExtraBold over the usual 1.2
taste.reason: Because tightly stacked heavy lines read as one block, leaving the airy 17-18px body to do the explaining

taste.name: Big rhythm, no rules
taste.trigger: When separating ~9 sections on a 10,000px page
taste.decision: Chose one fixed 128px gap between every section over dividers or alternating backgrounds
taste.reason: Because a constant pause teaches the reader where a topic ends without extra marks
evidence: cards inside sections at 32px radius, controls at 8px
